notes.title: "SUPER UFO FIGHTER Friend's Pass" appeared!!!!!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "SUPER UFO FIGHTER".

"SUPER UFO FIGHTER" has just celebrated its first anniversary since its distribution!
On this milestone occasion, we have prepared "SUPER UFO FIGHTER Friend's Pass" as a version that allows you to experience "SUPER UFO FIGHTER" in a simpler way

-----------------------------
[h3]【About SUPER UFO FIGHTER Friend's Pass】[/h3]
This is a free application that allows you to enjoy online play with people who own the full version of "SUPER UFO FIGHTER".

The application allows you to play online with people who own the full version of "SUPER UFO FIGHTER
Cross-play with different platforms is possible.

■■Matching procedure■■

A: Players playing with the full version of "SUPER UFO FIGHTER"

1)After launching the application, select "Online" from the main menu.
2)Select the connection region where you want to play the game.
3) Select "Friend Match" -> "Create Room" and tell the person you want to play with the 6-digit code that appears on the screen.

B: Players playing with "SUPER UFO FIGHTER Friend's Pass"

1) After launching the application, select "Online" from the main menu.
2) Select the same connection region as the player you want to play with.
3) Select "Friend Match" -> "Join a room" and enter the 6-digit code given to you by the player you are playing with.

When playing, make sure that the version displayed in the upper left corner of the "Online" mode menu ("Version : ○○") is the same as that of the player you are playing with.
If the version is not the same, you will not be able to play online.
-----------------------------
If you have the full version of the game or are thinking about playing with friends, please take advantage of the "SUPER UFO FIGHTER Friend's Pass" as well!

Thank you for your continued support of "SUPER UFO FIGHTER"

notes.title: "SUPER UFO FIGHTER" v1.1.0 update!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "SUPER UFO FIGHTER".

We have updated to v1.1.0 on 7/14.
The version number in the game has changed from "v1.1.0".

The contents of the update are as follows.
-----------------------------
◆◆ Battle in general◆◆
When the characters "Dr.Gow" and "Ning-Ning" are hit by the item "Reverse Smog", the direction of the attack is now reversed as well.

◆◆Online◆◆
The "Ranked Match" mode has been replaced by the "Quick Match" mode.
　The ranking system that existed in the past (matching band assignment, rank increase/decrease after battles) has been eliminated and it is now possible to be matched with all players.

Fixed a bug in the "Hot Potato" rule in Friend Match in which explosion counts were significantly off for both players communicating with each other.

In Friend Match, the time limit is now changed according to the number of victory scores set.

Fixed a bug in the "Super Ball" rule that caused the explosion counts of both players in communication to be significantly out of sync with each other.


◆◆Story◆◆
The story that has been cleared once now has a mark to indicate that it has been cleared.

The difficulty level of the fourth battle in the sixth story has been adjusted.

Fixed a bug in the menu that caused the screen display to become unintended when certain operations were performed.

◆◆Training◆◆◆

Fixed a problem in which some battle settings in "Target Battle" mode were taken over.

-----------------------------

*Applying the update will prevent communication with "v1.1.0" and earlier versions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168189/37dc937041f8ededbb25b19b06a0bf54b5ff11fe.png[/img]

Nintendo Switch version will be updated on the same day as well.

Thank you for your continued support of "SUPER UFO FIGHTER"

notes.title: "SUPER UFO FIGHTER" v1.0.1b update!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "SUPER UFO FIGHTER".

We have updated to v1.0.1b on 9/7.
The version number in the game has not changed from "v1.0.1".

【2022.9.8 Postscript.】 
The bug that prevented some players from connecting online, which occurred with this update, has been fixed.
The Build ID after the fix is "9470641". 
We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

How to check for the update
①Right-click "SUPER UFO FIGHTER" from the Steam library and select "Properties".
②Check the Build ID from "Update" in the properties.
③If the Build ID is [strike]"9460930"[/strike]"9470641", this update has been applied.

The contents of the update are as follows.
-----------------------------
◆Online
・The display filter is now applied when an inappropriate word is included in a name.

◆Campaign
・Fixed typos and omissions.

◆Museum
・Fixed a problem with Collection quantity in "Lab Coat", "Hachiko Statue", "Hercules Beetle", and "Golden Shuttle". The number of these objects you have already collected will be reset. Please be aware of this.
・The descriptions of some objects have been corrected.

◆Endless
・Fixed a problem in which "Music Room" was not unlocked when certain conditions were met. The "Music Room" will be unlocked when the game is launched for users who have already achieved the specified conditions.
・The condition to unlock "Music Room" has been changed from "11 wins in battle" to "10 wins in battle".

◆Others
・The display resolution has been changed when the game is launched for the first time.

-----------------------------
We will fix the same issues that have been confirmed for the Switch version at a later date.


Thank you for your continued support of "SUPER UFO FIGHTER"

notes.title: SUPER UFO FIGHTER Demo [Ver.1.2] Update Notice
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for playing the Demo version of SUPER UFO FIGHTER.
We will be updating the game with some new content on Wednesday, July 28, around 8:00 PM.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but please download the update when you play.

If you update to the latest version, you will not be able to communicate with people who are playing with the previous version.

[b]7.28 21:20 Update: The update file [ver 1.2.1] with some bug fixes is now available. We apologize for the inconvenience, but if you have already downloaded [ver 1.2], please update again.[/b]

—————————————————————————————————————————————————

SUPER UFO FIGHTER Demo [Ver.1.2] Update contents

[b][Game balance adjustment.][/b]

The weight of the capsules has been made slightly heavier.
Slightly weakened the strength of repulsion that occurs when items collide with both ends of the screen.
The time it takes for an item to appear in the warp pipe has been slightly increased.
Some minor adjustments have been made to the gimmicks in the ""Tsukinoura Factory"" stage.
A few other minor adjustments have been made.

[b][Bug Fixes][/b]

Online Mode
Fixed an issue where the player's movement speed was faster than in normal battles.
Addressed a rare issue where the player would not be displayed at the start of a battle, making it impossible to control.
Some other minor fixes in sound and graphics.

[b][Some minor fixes in sound and graphics.][/b]

The ""Emote"" function has been added. The ""Emote"" function has been added. During battle, you can express your emotions to the other player by pressing a specific button.

——————————————————————————————————————————————————

In this version 1.2, we have made some adjustments to reduce the number of unreasonable situations during battles, based on the feedback from the users who have played the game so far.
The ""Emotes"" feature was added on a trial basis in order to make online play more enjoyable.

This will be the only update during the online play period, but we will continue to observe changes in the competitive environment and make adjustments to the production version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168189/4639c81aff7dafccf375ca01a083f8bfec52f8ea.png[/img]
